Past Projects

Sleeper Agent

September 2025 - April 2026, POWERBOMB Studio

A top-down, asymmetrical, and aggressively CO-OP game. Play as two mischievous aliens with unique abilities, the heavy-hitting JUMBO and slick SLIM, tethered together as they drag along the unconscious body of a secret agent! I was Programmer Lead on the team, most my work focused around AI with dynamic path navigation and the combat experience. Built in Unity using C# and displayed at Level Up Showcase 2026.

Peas and Zees

September-December 2025

A top-down shooter game made for my course about learning advanced programming techniques. Understanding programming architect, AI using Finite State Machines, and implementing save systems via: PlayerPrefs, JSON Serialization, Binary Serialization, and Scriptable Objects. Built in Unity.

GPS Industry Project

September-December 2025

A industry project I partook in within a group of four. This is a snippet of the analysis paper of what we discovered. My significance on the team focused in data collection and data representation.

Cryptanalysis Genetic Algorithm Paper

September-December 2025

A paper I wrote toward my Introduction to Artificial Intelligence class. For research I created a program to implement a genetic algorithm (GA) in application to decryption of keys; cryptanalysis of the Vigenère cipher. Understanding how GA's work in inspiration of Darwin's theory of natural selection.

Program Synthesis Paper

September-December 2025

A paper I wrote for my Introduction to Artifical Intelligence class. To gather the data needed for said research paper, I had built a program to solve ARC program synthesis tasks with integration of informed search algorithms such as Breadth-First (BFS), Greedy-Breadth-First (GBFS), and A*.

CoExistence

January-April 2025

Here is a game I made toward a computer science course. Being able to create/manage threads and dabble in networking creating a client-server connection with two different interfaces's in terminal and a GUI with the option of mix & matching, all while being able to host multiple games at once.

Manticeps

January-April 2025, Grymbler Studios

Manticeps is a platformer side scroller in which you assume the role of a parasitic virus taking control of a mantis. Fight and infect your way to spread your mutation to all life. Get stronger as you acquire more mutations on your path of assimilation and carnage. Entitled as lead VFX artist and gameplay programmer, I found myself creating and learning much about particle systems, shaders, and etc in direct application to combat gameplay specifically tied to my other work of player movement and combat.
